overview: Large Magento catalogs often carry heavy pages and messy search settings. faq: Which hosting do I need for good speed?

Magento needs real resources. A shared plan often struggles, while a good VPS, managed Magento host or Adobe Commerce Cloud runs it well. We tell you honestly if your host is the main limit and suggest what to move to.
Do you install Varnish and Redis?
In Premium, yes, where your hosting plan and access allow it. On shared hosting these are often not available. We then tune what is possible and explain what a move would give you.
Can you promise a first-page ranking?
No. We improve what we control: speed, structure and markup. Rankings also depend on content, competitors and links, and we explain where to focus next in your report.
Will faster settings break my extensions?
Bundling and caching can clash with some extensions. We change one thing at a time on staging, test cart, checkout and search after each step and undo anything that causes trouble.
